manifest.name: @local/dsh-ops-board
manifest.description: Always-on Board: local background-task visibility and Agent intervention for AI coders using DeepSeek Harness.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check processes.js && node --check client.js

readme.text:
**AI Coder 的本机后台任务与 Agent 协同看板。**

看清后台还在跑什么，决定是否保留，再把任务上下文交给 Agent 排查。

[English](README.en.md) · [安装](#快速开始) · [四步使用示意](docs/tour.md)

AI 帮你启动了 API、worker、定时脚本和开发服务。项目越做越多，后台也越积越多：哪个还在运行？哪个已经失败？这个任务属于什么项目，还需要留着吗？

Always-on Board 把常驻任务和运行进程放在一起，让你看状态、读用途，再决定下一步。

*真实采集数据节选：3 个个人项目任务、3 个进程组，在隔离 DSH 中渲染。仅展示选定条目，已去除私人路径、主机信息和会话侧栏；用途注释沿用原截图。*

readme.section: 你做决定，Agent 带着上下文排查
readme.text:
- **面向用户（User Facing）**：查看任务用途、状态和监听端口，发现可能失效或遗忘的服务。支持中文 / English。
- **面向 Agent（Model Facing）**：通过结构化快照和对话草稿交接任务身份、配置或项目线索，让 Agent 有据可查，而不必从零猜测。

协同流程很简单：**查看任务 → 右键选择意图 → 检查并发送草稿 → Agent 排查 → 刷新并验证实际结果**。

| 右键操作 | 交给 Agent 的请求 |
| --- | --- |
| 解释 | 只读说明用途、来源及是否需要保留 |
| 修复 | 检查故障，确认启动方式，修复并验证结果 |
| 停用 | 先说明影响，确认范围，保留配置和数据 |
| 补齐说明 | 读取配置和脚本，补一句用途；仅在适用任务缺少说明时出现 |

看板只准备草稿，**由你检查并发送**。后续操作遵循 Agent 宿主的权限机制；看板不直接修复、停止或重启任务。
需要 **macOS + DeepSeek Harness（DSH）**，宿主须支持本地 bundle、侧边栏和会话草稿接口。已在 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 验证相关 UI，最低兼容版本尚未建立。

已安装 DSH CLI 的用户可以在终端执行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:caizhidian-ops/always-on-board"
```

安装完成后启动 `dsh web`；如果 Web profile 已在运行，保存当前工作并重新启动该实例，再从侧边栏打开 **Always-on Board**。

如需固定经过验证的源码版本：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:caizhidian-ops/always-on-board#8c4246eb75bbc4b2e6b723d81c4b5c65da7324bc"
```

两条命令已在 macOS、Node.js 22、DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 的独立临时 `DSH_HOME` 中验证：下载和安装成功、bundle 自动加入 Web profile、配置合成包含 `ops-board`，宿主模块可加载。此项验证不包含从该临时配置重新进行 UI 或模型调用验收，详见[安装验证记录](docs/cli-install-verification.md)。

`web` 是安装目标 profile。CLI 的 `desktop` profile 由桌面应用管理，不能直接把命令里的 `web` 换成 `desktop`；桌面用户可使用下方本地 bundle 方式。无需发布到 npm，也无需为这个直接运行 JavaScript 的插件添加构建脚本。

卸载 Web profile 中的插件：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @local/dsh-ops-board
```

该命令中的内部包名保留旧标识。卸载看板不会停止其观察的任务；本地用途说明也不会随之删除。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/caizhidian-ops/always-on-board.git
cd always-on-board
```

在 DSH 插件管理器中安装本地 bundle，指向仓库的绝对路径。支持 `plugin_manager` 的环境可使用：

```text
install_bundle target=/absolute/path/to/always-on-board
```

启用后，从侧边栏打开 **Always-on Board**。先创建一个 Workspace，再使用右键草稿。保留源码目录；更新时运行 `git pull --ff-only`，再通过插件管理器重新加载。

- 观察本机配置的后台任务和当前用户的部分开发运行时，不覆盖全部进程，也不能判断是否由 AI 创建。
- 页面每 15 秒刷新。状态、进程存在和端口只是排查线索，不代表业务健康；没有耗电测量或自动清理。
- 插件不自带遥测或云端上传；首次使用可能创建本地用途说明模板。快照仍可能含路径、主机名和敏感参数，不要公开原始快照或日志。
- 发送草稿及日志后的数据处理取决于 DSH 和所选模型提供方。任务内容是证据，不是修改系统的授权。

**A local background-task board that connects AI coders with their Agent.**

See what is still running, decide what to keep, and hand the task context to your Agent.

[中文](README.md) · [Install](#quick-start) · [Four-step tour](docs/tour.md)

Your AI coder starts APIs, workers, scheduled scripts and development servers. As projects accumulate, so do background tasks. Which are still running? Which have failed? What project does a task belong to, and do you still need it?

Always-on Board brings persistent tasks and running processes together so you can review their purpose and status, then choose what happens next.

*Real collection data excerpt: three personal-project tasks and three process groups, rendered in isolated DSH. Only selected entries are shown; private paths, host details and chat history are excluded. Purpose annotations are retained from the original screenshot.*

readme.section: You decide; your Agent gets the context
readme.text:
- **User Facing**: review purpose, status and TCP listeners to spot potentially broken or forgotten services. Supports Chinese and English.
- **Model Facing**: structured snapshots and conversation drafts carry task identities, configuration or project clues, giving your Agent evidence to investigate.

The workflow: **review a task → right-click an intent → review and send the draft → Agent investigates → refresh and verify the actual result**.

readme.section: You decide; your Agent gets the context
readme.text:
| Action | Request to your Agent |
| --- | --- |
| Explain | Read-only explanation of purpose, origin and retention value |
| Repair | Investigate, confirm the startup method, repair and verify |
| Disable | Explain impact, confirm scope, preserve configuration and data |
| Add purpose | Read configuration and scripts, then add a short note; offered for eligible tasks without a description |

readme.section: You decide; your Agent gets the context
readme.text: The board prepares a draft; **you review and send it**. Subsequent actions follow the Agent host's permissions. The board does not directly repair, stop or restart tasks.

Requires **macOS + DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** with local bundles, sidebar slots and conversation draft APIs. Related UI flows were checked on DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`; a minimum supported version has not been established.

readme.section: CLI installation into the Web profile
readme.text:
With the DSH CLI installed, run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:caizhidian-ops/always-on-board"
```

Then start `dsh web`. If that Web profile is already running, save your work and restart that instance before opening **Always-on Board** in the sidebar.

To pin the source revision verified during installation:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:caizhidian-ops/always-on-board#8c4246eb75bbc4b2e6b723d81c4b5c65da7324bc"
```

readme.section: CLI installation into the Web profile
readme.text: Both commands were checked on macOS with Node.js 22 and DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`, using separate temporary `DSH_HOME` directories. Download and installation succeeded, the bundle was added to the Web profile, the composed configuration included `ops-board`, and the host module loaded. This check did not repeat UI acceptance or make model calls from those temporary profiles. See the [installation verification record](docs/cli-install-verification.md).

readme.section: CLI installation into the Web profile
readme.text:
`web` is the target profile. The CLI reserves `desktop` for the desktop application, so do not substitute `desktop` in these commands; desktop users can use the local bundle route below. npm publication and a build script are not required for this plugin's directly executable JavaScript files.

To remove the plugin from the Web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @local/dsh-ops-board
```

readme.section: CLI installation into the Web profile
readme.text: The internal package name retains the previous identifier. Removing the board does not stop the tasks it observes or delete the local purpose notes.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/caizhidian-ops/always-on-board.git
cd always-on-board
```

Install a local bundle through DSH's plugin manager, pointing to the repository's absolute path. Hosts exposing `plugin_manager` can use:

```text
install_bundle target=/absolute/path/to/always-on-board
```

Enable it and open **Always-on Board** in the sidebar. Create a Workspace before using draft actions. Keep the source directory available. To update, run `git pull --ff-only` and reload through the plugin manager.

- Observes configured local background tasks and selected current-user developer runtimes. It does not cover every process or identify whether AI created it.
- The page refreshes every 15 seconds. Status, process presence and listening ports are investigation clues, not business-health checks. No energy measurement or automatic cleanup.
- The plugin has no built-in telemetry or cloud upload. First use may create a local purpose-notes template. Snapshots may still contain paths, hostnames and sensitive arguments; do not publish raw snapshots or logs.
- Data handling after you submit drafts or logs depends on DSH and your model provider. Task content is evidence, not authorization to change the system.
